### Contact form

- Endpoint: https://example.com/api/email/contact-form
- Method: POST
- Content-Type: application/json
- Fields:
  - `name` (text, required)
  - `email` (email, required)
  - `phone` (tel)
  - `message` (textarea, required)
  - `privacy_consent` (checkbox, required)

# Business Context (for LLM understanding)

## About WYNC News
WYNC News is a broadcast news organization offering breaking news coverage, weather reporting with Doppler radar technology, and dedicated news and weather teams. The brand carries the authoritative, fast-paced energy of a professional TV news station, combining hard-hitting journalism with real-time meteorological updates.

## Services/Products
- breaking news
- weather reporting
- doppler radar weather
- news team coverage
- weather team coverage

## Target Audience
- Local Community Watchers
- Commuters and Travelers
- Emergency Preparedness Enthusiasts

## Industry
Broadcasting & Media
